tips.text: When a conduit rolls Ghoul Eruption, let the enemies destroy it and camp that round, unless it is the round's last conduit; ghouls keep pouring out.
Bring Nekros with Desecrate and Slash weapons for extra drop rolls.
Watch for Ghoul Expired and Ghoul Rictus by name; ghouls look like ordinary Grineer mid-fight, so players run rounds thinking none spawned.
Keep running rounds if no conduit rolls Ghoul Eruption yet; it can wait until round 4 or later.
Expect about half an hour of Olympus Disruption for the set, with Tak & Lug along the way.
